title: やまなし (Yamanashi) — 宮沢賢治
description: Two short vignettes by 宮沢賢治 (Miyazawa Kenji), set at the bottom of a stream. In May, two young crabs watch a kingfisher (かわせみ) dive and take a fish; in December, a ripe crabapple (やまなし) falls into the moonlit water and the family follows its fragrant drift downstream. The story is famous for its luminous water imagery and the invented word クラムボン — a creature the crabs observe but never define. First published April 8, 1923. (~1,800 characters)
